title: WMG ACQUIRES LEADING GERMAN INDIE DISTRIBUTOR ZEBRALUTION MUSIC

body_markdown:
##### *Distributor to operate under current leadership while integrating WMG’s proprietary technology, including Revelator tools, for label partners*


Warner Music Group (WMG) today announced the acquisition of Zebralution Music GmbH, a spin-off of Zebralution GmbH and a premier distributor for independent record labels in Germany and across Europe, from Bookwire, a leading publishing tech provider that acquired the Zebralution group this year.


Zebralution Music’s existing leadership will remain in place under Co-Founders and Co-CEOs Konrad von Löhneysen and Sascha Lazimbat, who will work closely with Niels Walboomers, President of Warner Music Central Europe, to align strategic operations.


Zebralution Music’s partner labels will continue to benefit from the distributor’s deep local expertise while gaining direct access to WMG’s advanced technology suite, including the state-of-the-art distribution, analytics, and financial tools powered by music tech and digital distribution platform Revelator, which WMG acquired earlier this year.


Sascha Lazimbat, Co-CEO of Zebralution Music, says: “This is an exciting new chapter for Zebralution Music, but for our label partners and the people we work with every day, it will very much be business as usual. We’ll continue to operate with the same team, the same relationships and the same commitment to delivering the best possible service. What does change is the additional technology and resources now available to us, which will help us build on what we have already achieved.”


Konrad von Loehneysen, Co-CEO of Zebralution Music, adds: “Zebralution Music has always been built around understanding the needs of indie labels and providing a personal, flexible service. Our partners can expect the same people, the same approach and the same independence they’ve always valued. It’s easy to say for me, as my label Embassy of Music has been a client for 20 plus years and will continue to be so.”


Niels Walboomers, President, Warner Music Central Europe, adds: “Konrad and Sascha have built one of the most trusted homes for independent music in Europe, and a team that labels genuinely believe in. Zebralution’s deep regional expertise, combined with our technology and global reach, gives its partners world-class capabilities without asking them to give up their independence.”
